description: This PHP script manages the 'banner-advanced' page in the Revive Adserver admin interface, handling banner preferences, form processing, security checks, navigation, and rendering HTML form for editing banner prepend and append HTML snippets.

classes.name: OA_Permission
classes.description: Handles permission enforcement for user accounts and object access.

classes.name: OA_Dal
classes.description: Data Access Layer for database operations related to banners.

methods.name: enforceAccount
methods.description: Enforces that the current user has a specific account type.

methods.name: enforceAccessToObject
methods.description: Checks if the user has access to a specific object type.

methods.name: checkSessionToken
methods.description: Validates the session token for form submission security.

methods.name: factoryDO
methods.description: Creates a Data Object for database operations.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the current entity ID for permission checks.

methods.name: displayNavigationBanner
methods.description: Displays navigation links for campaigns and banners.

methods.name: queueMessage
methods.description: Queues a message to be displayed to the user.
